entities.summary: Nikolai Markin was a Bolshevik revolutionary and sailor. His parents had been textile workers in a factory in the Penza Province, but they subsequently moved to Vladikavkaz. He was a member of the central Executive Committee of the First Congress of Soviets in 1917.
